paragraphs.text: General is an obsolete creature type for a high ranking commander of an army.

General was a creature type that debuted in The Dark on Orc General . In the Grand Creature Type Update , the type was made obsolete and changed to be just Warrior . Numerous planes and races in the Multiverse have armies with generals. Usually they are now under either the soldier type though a few have also appeared as allies , samurai , and warriors .
